in_marathi.name: Rihansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Vishnu's protection
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rihansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rihansh is derived from the name Rama, which means 'protection' or 'delight'. It is believed that the name Rihansh symbolizes the protection and blessings of Lord Vishnu. It is a powerful and royal name, evoking feelings of courage and victory.
